topic: Asking for a Rental Car Upgrade

script.title: ASKING FOR A RENTAL CAR UPGRADE
script.scene_zh: 租車門市 · 申請升級
script.story_hook: A reserved economy car is sold out at the counter.
script.intro_zh: 櫃台說預訂的經濟型車出租完了，必須現場改主意。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back, road trippers! Today we're upgrading a rental car.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎回來，公路旅行的朋友們！今天來幫租的車升級。
script.outro: End of the road for today! Listen, repeat, and go.
script.outro_zh: 今天的行程就到站囉！聽一遍、跟讀一遍，出發吧。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat the useful lines, one by one.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一句一句跟讀這些實用句型。
script.char_a_description: a cheerful man in his early thirties with wavy brown hair and a short beard, faded orange flannel over a band tee, a film camera bouncing on a strap around his neck
script.char_b_description: a bright-eyed rental agent in her twenties with a blonde high ponytail, navy polo with a car-key logo, spinning a key fob on one finger while she types
script.youtube_title: 【🚗租車升級實戰英文】「有什麼條件嗎？」一次聽懂🧳💺空間・保險・第二位駕駛全搞定｜出國必聽英文｜Rental Car English
script.youtube_title_en: “What's the Catch?” — Asking for a Rental Car Upgrade
script.youtube_description:
預訂的車型租完了怎麼辦？別慌！這段櫃台對話教你當場要升級、問條件、比價格。從中型車免費升級、第二位駕駛，到保險怎麼問，18 句美式日常英語附上繁體中文與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽完就敢開口。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
Your reserved economy car is sold out — now what? This counter conversation teaches you to ask for an upgrade, check for a catch, and compare prices on the spot. Mid-size upgrade, second driver, and insurance questions — 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA plus a listen-and-repeat finish.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🚗租車升級英文｜現場升級・加駕駛費用・保險問法｜聽完就會租車｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
興高采烈去取車，預訂的車型卻早就租完了？
當場要升級、問條件，英文該怎麼開口才不吃虧？

這一集帶大家走進機場旁的租車門市，跟著旅客從確認訂單、爭取免費升級，到問清第二位駕駛與保險細節，全程都用自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🚙 爭取升級：例如 “The economy is sold out.”、“I can offer you a mid-size for free.”。
💬 問條件與加價：例如 “What's the catch?”、“It's twenty more a day, taxes included.”。
🧾 確認駕駛與保險：例如 “Is anyone else going to drive?”、“Does the rate include basic insurance?”。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次取車遇到缺車，別緊張——你已經知道怎麼把壞消息變成一趟升級！
script.thumbnail_action: handing over a car key fob

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I reserved an economy car for three days.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪ ˈrɛ·zɜrd ən ɪˈkɑ·nə·mi kɑr fər θri deɪz/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我預訂了一台經濟型車，租三天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check… hmm, economies are sold out.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi tʃɛk hʌm ɪˈkɑ·nə·miz ɑr soʊld aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 讓我查一下……嗯，經濟型都租完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh! Is anything else available today?
dialogue.zh: 噢！那今天還有別的車可以選嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, I can offer you a mid-size for free.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl aɪ kæn ˈɔ·fər ju ə mɪd saɪz fər fri/
dialogue.zh: 這樣吧，我可以免費提供一台中型車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? A free upgrade? What's the catch?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɪ·li ə fri ˈʌpˌɡreɪd wʌts ðə kætʃ/
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？免費升級？有什麼條件嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No catch — same price, bigger trunk.
dialogue.zh: 沒條件——一樣價位，行李箱更大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That actually works — we've got four big bags.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈæk·tʃu·ə·li wɜrks wiːv ɡɑt fɔr bɪɡ bæɡz/
dialogue.zh: 那剛好——我們有四個大行李箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The SUV fits them easy, if you'd prefer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˌɛs·juːˈvi fɪts ðəm ˈi·zi ɪf jud prɪˈfɜr/
dialogue.zh: 休旅車裝得輕而易舉，如果您比較想要大的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, does the SUV cost extra per day?
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm dʌz ði ˌɛs·juːˈvi kɔst ˈɛk·strə pər deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，休旅車每天會多花多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty more a day, taxes included.
dialogue.zh: 一天多二十塊，稅金都包含了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We'll take the mid-size, then. Thanks.
dialogue.phonetic: /wil teɪk ðə mɪd saɪz ðɛn θæŋks/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good call. Is anyone else going to drive?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd kɔl ɪz ˈɛ·niwʌn ɛls ˈɡoʊ·ɪŋ tə draɪv/
dialogue.zh: 好的。還有別人也會開嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just my wife and me. Does that cost?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst maɪ waɪf ənd mi dʌz ðæt kɔst/
dialogue.zh: 只有我和我太太。加駕駛要錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Second driver is free today — lucky you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛ·kənd ˈdraɪ·vər ɪz fri təˈdeɪ ˈlʌ·ki ju/
dialogue.zh: 今天第二位駕駛免費——你好幸運。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice! Um, does the rate include basic insurance?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs ʌm dʌz ðə reɪt ɪnˈkluːd ˈbeɪ·sɪk ɪn·ˈʃʊr·əns/
dialogue.zh: 太好了！呃，費率有包含基本保險嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 第三方責任已涵蓋；撞擊險要另外計費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our card covers that, so we're all set.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊr kɑrd ˈkʌ·vərz ðæt soʊ wɪr ɔl sɛt/
dialogue.zh: 我們的信用卡有保，所以都搞定了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect. Your keys are ready at bay seven!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜr·fɪkt jɔr kiːz ɑr ˈrɛ·di æt beɪ ˈsɛ·vən/
dialogue.zh: 完美。第七車位的鑰匙已經好了！
